context: Daichi and Tatsuya plan a new festival for the town.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: たつや、新しい祭り、考えたで。
lines.en: Tatsuya, I've been thinking about this new festival idea.
lines.style: Bright, energetic opening with Kansai inflection. Leans forward slightly. Genuine warmth and excitement threading through—he's not performing, he's inviting. Soft on the trailing particle.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Unhurried, curious. Low warm tone. Takes the moment in. No rush to fill air. Genuine interest sitting underneath the simple words. Slight pause after the question mark.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 子供たち、中心、皆で、楽しめる。
lines.en: Kids at the center. Something everyone can enjoy together.
lines.style: Building energy but not rushing. Kansai swing on the rhythm. Breaking it into pieces—deliberate, like painting the picture. Soft real warmth, not performing warmth. Leaning in.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: That's nice. Give the town some real life again.
lines.style: Quiet philosophical note underneath. Slow, unhurried delivery. He sees beyond the festival—sees what it could mean. Warm but not sentimental. A gentle nod in his voice.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: A hand extended in his voice. Warm, bright conviction. Not commanding—inviting. The Kansai warmth peaks here. Energized but genuinely collaborative. Opens the door wide.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: Yeah. Everyone puts in at times like this.
lines.style: Quiet strength underneath. Not sentimental, but truthful. He knows communities. Low, steady tone. A small nod in the delivery—agreement that runs deep. Tender without softness.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: This is gonna be a fun place.
lines.style: Closing warmth. Certainty without pushiness. Kansai inflection peaks gently. Gazing forward. Soft real joy—the kind that comes from knowing something matters. Trailing off with gentle anticipation.
